warnings.claim: The sustainability-related financial disclosures are prepared for the same reporting entity as the related general purpose financial statements.
The sustainability-related financial disclosures cover the same reporting period as the related financial statements and are reported at the same time.
Amounts presented in currency are reported in euros (EUR), the same presentation currency as the related financial statements.
The reporting year is 2024 with a fiscal year end of 31 December 2024.
Where comparative information is presented, the comparative years are 2022 and 2023.

The disclosures should be read together with the related financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2024, because some measures (for example, Tier 1 capital) are also presented in general purpose financial reporting.

The disclosures provide multi-year information for selected measures (including climate capex and Tier 1 capital) across 2022–2024 and include change monitoring via a "changed since prior period" indicator and defined monitoring frequencies (monthly, quarterly, semi-annual).

claims.claim_text: The entity applies NGFS v4 Net Zero 2050 using a top-down sector-pathway approach to the banking book; carbon price assumptions from the IEA NZE 2050 trajectory are mapped to counterparty NACE sectors; stranded asset estimates are derived from sector-level fossil fuel capex exposure; scope covers lending exposures across DE, FR, IT, NL and ES.
claims.support_notes: Method and scope described; no quantitative outputs provided here.

claims.claim_text: Under orderly transition scenarios, the portfolio demonstrates adequate resilience with transition risk losses remaining within Pillar 2 capital buffer thresholds; under disorderly transition scenarios, near-term resilience is acceptable but medium-term capital consumption from stranded asset impairments is material, and additional capital buffers may be required post-2030 under the most adverse disorderly assumptions.
claims.support_notes: Qualitative resilience conclusions and capital linkage; lacks quantified loss/capital figures.
